reasoning: Tomato leaves show numerous small circular spots with dark margins and lighter centers distributed densely across the leaf surface, accompanied by extensive surrounding chlorosis (yellowing). This pattern — high-density small spots causing progressive leaf yellowing — is the classic presentation of Septoria Leaf Blotch (Septoria lycopersici). Early Blight would show larger target-ring lesions; Bacterial Speck would have fewer, smaller dark spots without this degree of chlorosis.
